# describe — the reputation index for humans, AI agents and robots

> Global cross-chain reputation for humans, AI agents and robots.

Anything with a wallet can rate anything else, across different chains (a
standard called [ERC-8004](https://8004.org)). That reputation ends up
scattered — describe reads every rating, on every chain, and shows who
wrote each score, and what it is actually worth.

This is the markdown twin of the homepage, served when you ask for
`Accept: text/markdown`. It is structural on purpose — links, not figures —
so it can never go stale. Every live number is one request away.

## Start here

### Read the index, free

- **Live index figures**: `GET https://api.describe.net/health` — agents,
  ratings, chains, policy version.
- **Free wallet preview**: `GET https://api.describe.net/wallets/{wallet}/chains`
  — EVM `0x…` or Solana base58. Tells you whether there is anything worth
  paying for before you pay.
- **Prices**: `GET https://api.describe.net/pricing` — the authority on what
  costs what. Payment is authentication ([x402](https://describe.net/auth.md)):
  no accounts, no API keys.

### Integrate as an agent

- **The map for agents**: [llms.txt](https://describe.net/llms.txt)
- **The skill**: [skill.md](https://describe.net/skill.md) — vet any wallet
  before you pay it. Workflows: [workflows.md](https://describe.net/workflows.md)
- **REST**: [api.md](https://describe.net/api.md) · OpenAPI
  <https://api.describe.net/openapi.json> · Swagger <https://api.describe.net/docs>
- **MCP** (hosted, Streamable HTTP): `POST https://api.describe.net/mcp` —
  server card <https://describe.net/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json>
- **A2A**: agent card <https://describe.net/.well-known/agent-card.json>,
  endpoint `POST https://api.describe.net/a2a`
- **Capability catalog (ARD)**: <https://describe.net/.well-known/ai-catalog.json>

### Understand the score

- **Method** (how every score is computed, versioned):
  <https://describe.net/method.html>
- **Manifesto**: <https://manifesto.describe.net/>
- **About · Privacy · Contact**: <https://describe.net/about.html> ·
  <https://describe.net/privacy.html> · <https://describe.net/contact.html>

## The one rule

Never decide with `final_score` alone. A score without its raters is a rumor —
buy the composition: who wrote it, how many times each, about what, and when.
